hypothesis: An accepted expected-value response is not enough. Execute every fixed first-rank proposal and audit its complete program to learn whether the codec and reasoning changes reduce stale expectations without losing valid controlled failures.
cohort: All 16 first-rank programs offered in round9. Include round8 raw-disabled completions as the fourth arm. N01 has no typed expected slot and remains excluded from the component but present in the 17-trial denominator.
guards: Revalidate saved completions with frozen codecs.
Do not read evaluation labels or native outcomes when constructing or selecting proposals.
Clear stale probe state and verify complete emitted test AST before native execution.
Use all derived programs; do not stop an arm or choose a per-task winner from its native result.
limitations: No fresh whole-test model gate is available while external-provider approval remains pending.
Independent complete-test audit is required for a valid defect witness.
This is a matched construction diagnostic, not an all-17 detector result.
Structured arm bundles value encoding, constant-oracle masking and fixed-expression handling; it is not a single-change causal ablation.
provider_cost: Prior 48 round9 requests plus the 16 previously recorded raw-disabled requests. New provider calls are zero. Report their receipt costs separately from new native execution.
findings: Each arm produces one valid controlled failure trial, N02. No construction arm improves coverage in this fixed first-rank component.

Raw enabled reasoning gives six valid complete programs versus three for raw disabled, and removes three invalid controlled failures while abstaining on additional inputs. One emitted P6 failure remains contract-uncertain.
Structured values without high reasoning increase acceptance from 11 to 14 but leave the number of valid programs at three. More accepted syntax is not improved semantics.
Structured enabled and raw enabled both give six valid complete programs. The structured arm additionally admits inapplicable setup and stale-observer programs.
The N05 corrected expected operands pass natively. This eliminates a stale-oracle failure but discovers no defect.
The N08 highest-durable assertion contradicts the existing SeqNum record numbering and issue wording, although the candidate implementation passes it. Passing behavior is not oracle authority.
Python nested list/tuple identity, invocation-dependent helper operands, and dynamic symbolic expectations remain limitations of the value interface.

accounting.semantic_review_independence: The primary agent reviewed full tests and source contracts. This is evaluation-only and not a blind human study.

native_limitations: Four N06 runs have a nonzero Go parent outcome without normalized failing leaves; N07 has a control/build execution error; both N04 proposals have failing source controls. None is counted as a controlled defect witness.
